Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules associated with document CHEMBL3886467. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, then inner join compound_structures on molregno to ensure canonical_smiles is present. Filter docs by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3886467'. Return chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
